## About the Event

CINFRAis a National Level Technical Symposium organized by our illustrious institution, MGIT, annually since 2013. The symposium has become a trademark of knowledge and has enhanced the reputation of the department. It is a stage for every student to let their voice be heard, paving the way for creating awareness about emerging Civil Engineering trends across the world. Enthusiasts from many colleges participate in and witness the symposium, which includes many thought-provoking events apart from a general symposium.
